name: The Chained Saint
place: dungeon crypt_spiral SET B: floor 2's mini-boss (the last ring room, 24 m square)
_doc: Stream E (M2). A statue of a saint the monks chained down — for good reason. Four chain posts hold it; they also give cover from its Gaze (line of sight). Its Shackle Pull drags the farthest player in. P2 'Grave Flood' at 45%: grave-water rises in pools that STAY (chill + damage), so the room shrinks; when the floor floods it calls 'climb the plinths' — two safe circles at the old plinths.
party: Solo: fine with care — the Gaze is the killer, keep a post between you. 2-3: spread around posts so the pull only drags one. 5: posts crowd; plinth safe spots fit ~3 each. M5 scaling: more posts or wider plinths at five; fewer flood pools solo.

pull: Stone grinds. The chained statue turns its head toward you.
The chains go taut. The Saint has noticed you.
say.death: The Saint cracks from crown to plinth and the chains finally go slack.
say.reset: The Saint settles, stone-still, chains clinking.

enrage.say: The Saint tears its chains free of the floor!

gaze.name: Saint's Gaze
gaze.say: The Saint's eyes kindle — get behind a chain post!

flood.name: Grave Water Rises
flood.say: Black water wells up through the flagstones.

plinths.name: The Flood
plinths.say: The whole floor floods — climb onto the plinths!

phases.name: Grave Flood
phases.say: Water pours from the Saint's stone eyes.

do.say: Every chain post is down. Nothing stands between you and its gaze.
